about: The Case Handler works from Broadway opposite City Hall and is one of the few firms in this ranking that says who does what: Adam Handler and Matthew Goodstein as attorneys, and four paralegals named as paralegals.

220 reviews at 5.0. It publishes 151 case results with amounts of its own, the longest such list in this market after Hach & Rose, and they are its figures rather than ones we confirmed. Its home page takes more than three minutes to paint its largest element on mobile, which is the slowest reading in the directory by a wide margin.
